parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Logstash cluster.

parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Specifies whether to deploy the pipeline immediately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-pipelines --instance-id ls-cn-oew1qbgl0000 --trigger false --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
